description: This Kotlin source file defines the InvokeDispatcher class and related functions for handling various device/task commands within an Android application, specifically managing commands related to UI, camera, location, device info, notifications, system operations, and more. It includes logic for command validation, capability checks, and delegation to specific handlers.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: Main class responsible for dispatching and executing various commands received, handling capabilities, and delegating to specific handlers for UI, camera, location, device info, notifications, etc.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main suspend function that processes incoming commands based on their string identifier, performs validation, and delegates to specific handlers or returns errors.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Helper suspend function to ensure the A2UI host is ready before executing related commands.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Helper suspend function to execute a block with the canvas available, catching exceptions and providing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks the availability of required capabilities for commands, returning an appropriate error or null if available.
